text:
vikram (sec_eng): TritonCap sent over a vendor security questionnaire after our call — they want: 12-month RBAC change log for keystore roles, proof that private keys never left tenant HSMs, a 7-day SIEM ingest sample, and an example CVE triage for a KMS library vuln. They want the packet next Wed.

emily (solutions_eng): ok. For the "proof keys never left HSM" item do they want signed manifests or audit trace? I asked for clarification.

rebecca (acct_mgr): TritonCap replied: prefer vendor-signed artifact + audit export CSV. They also asked if PGP signing is available.

qaguy (qsa): For auditors: signed manifest (key_id, created_at, rotated_at, signer) + control-plane audit extract showing ImportKey/ExportKey/GetPublicKey events. If ExportKey is never called, include the zero-result query + screenshot. PGP preferred but a PDF with an audit trail is acceptable if signed by an authorized operator.

vikram (sec_eng): Good. We can produce: signed manifest template, redaction guidance, control-plane audit CSV (timestamp, tenant, api_method, requester, request_id), role-binding snapshot (SCIM export), and a SIEM pipeline sample.

sam (eng-infra): I'll pull RBAC change events and the SIEM sample. Plan: RBAC CSV for last 12 months with columns: timestamp, actor, change_type, role, target, ticket_link. SIEM: 7 days from staging forwarder (no customer PII) and the pipeline transform showing CEF/syslog -> normalized event example.

emily (solutions_eng): I'll draft the signed manifest template and a short doc for TritonCap on how to sign (PGP preferred) plus a one-page FAQ.

rebecca (acct_mgr): I'll confirm whether TritonCap wants 90 days or 12 months for the SIEM sample. They said 90 days is fine if we justify.

vault-bot: evidence ticket created: TC-EVID-3308 [SIGNED_MANIFEST_TEMPLATE, RBAC_CHANGE_CSV, KMS_AUDIT_CSV, SIEM_7DAY_SAMPLE, CVE_TRIAGE_SAMPLE, REDACTION_GUIDE].

qaguy (qsa): For the CVE triage include a sanitized timeline: detection, assign severity (CVSS), affected components, patch status, mitigations, and customer notification cadence. One sanitized example is sufficient.

vikram (sec_eng): Example control-plane query I'll run for ExportKey (internal):
```
SELECT timestamp, tenant_id, api_method, requester_principal, request_id
FROM controlplane.audit_events
WHERE tenant_id = 'tritoncap-prod'
  AND api_method = 'ExportKey'
  AND timestamp >= '2025-03-01';
```
If zero rows, we'll attach the query and the zero-result screenshot. If not zero, we'll include the ticket and approver.

sam (eng-infra): Note on ephemeral creds: TritonCap asked how we track short-lived tokens. We'll produce a single end-to-end trace: STS issue -> role assumption -> KMS calls -> token expiration. We'll hash request_ids for privacy and provide a mapping file for the QSA under NDA.

emily (solutions_eng): Any preference on PGP vs signed PDF? We can provide both if they prefer.

qaguy (qsa): Both is fine but PGP is cleaner for non-repudiation. Include signer identity and method in the manifest.

vikram (sec_eng): Action list:
- emily: SIGNED_MANIFEST_TEMPLATE + FAQ (due: 48h)
- sam: RBAC_CHANGE_CSV + KMS_AUDIT_CSV + SIEM_SAMPLE (due: 72h)
- emily: REDACTION_GUIDE + cover note draft for TritonCap (due: 72h)
- qaguy: review CVE_TRIAGE_SAMPLE when ready (due: 96h)

rebecca (acct_mgr): I'll tell TritonCap we'll aim to deliver by Wed and ask if they require PGP exclusively.

vikram (sec_eng): One more: include a short excerpt of our incident notification playbook (T+0, T+24, T+72) and a redacted incident timeline to show customer notification flow.

sam (eng-infra): pulling extracts now, pinging @eng-infra-access for export role. Will strip IPs and SSO usernames.

emily (solutions_eng): I'll prepare the manifest template and an example PGP signature steps doc.

qaguy (qsa): I'll review artifacts before we hand them to TritonCap. Tag me in TC-EVID-3308.

vikram (sec_eng): Thanks team — keep updates in this thread. If anyone sees ExportKey events, flag immediately so we can capture approvals.

rebecca (acct_mgr): noted. I'll update TritonCap after we confirm timeframes. :white_check_mark:
